summary: Split the strict kit play matrix across two stable-hash CI shards without weakening full-index coverage or the fractal-web gate.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CI-only. Each shard validates the full index and runs all four cases for its SHA-256-assigned stories. The aggregate gate requires every shard receipt and exact case coverage. Artifact names and receipts bind run ID, tested SHA and attempt; rerun-failed-jobs may retain older successful shards only from that exact run/SHA, with each shard's newest receipt authoritative. App lanes and browser isolation/negative controls stay on shard 0. Shard summaries and receipts report case results, play minutes and duplicated Storybook build cost.

manual.detail: No manual step; change kitShardCount in workspace-ci.ts to configure the shard count.
